title: Pliers with a nylon pouch
description: aluminum pliers with stainless steel jaws and a fitted nylon pouch
reference_excerpt: The product in question is described as aluminum pliers with stainless steel jaws and an aluminum body, which includes a tungsten carbide cutter. The relevant HTSUS classification falls under subheading 8203.20.6030, which covers "pliers (including cutting pliers), pincers, tweezers and similar tools, and parts thereof: other: other (except parts), pliers." This classification is appropriate as the product is a type of hand tool specifically designed for gripping and cutting, which aligns with the definition provided in the HTSUS.
